newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit remains in forecast range ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit remains in forecast range ahead of weekend.

text.p: The ringgit was confined to its forecast range ahead of the weekend as activity thinned in afternoon Asian trading, dealers said on Friday.
They said the ringgit remained under pressure on institutional sales and commercial dollar demand from Kuala Lumpur.
"The market has slowed but ringgit still has downside to it," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
"Dollar/ringgit is still fundamentally bid. There'll be resistance at 2.5070/80 initially and then at 2.5120," said a European bank dealer in Singapore.
The ringgit earlier recovered from the overnight low of 2.5075 a dollar as the Singapore dollar's rise against the Malaysian unit capped the rise of dollar/ringgit.
"Unless dollar/ringgit breaks last night's high, it will remain in the present range," one dealer said.
Dealers said commercial demand for the dollars will continue to push up dollar/ringgit in the near future.
At 0700 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5050/60 a dollar against 2.5063/73 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Thursday. The Singapore dollar was at 0.5618/24 per ringgit against 0/5626/31.
